metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: TRL progressions are reasonable: T03 (TRL7) completing in 2 years, T01 (TRL6) in 3 years, and T02 (TRL5) in 3 years are all achievable within industry norms for automotive electronics, with no unrealistic single-step jumps evident.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolio, but T03 at TRL7 is already near-commercial and T01 at TRL6 is mid-mature; only T02 at TRL5 fits a genuine technology leadership posture, creating mixed strategic signals.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are domain-relevant for an Autonomous Driving/ADAS company, but SiC semiconductor manufacturing is a materials/fab domain where automotive OEMs typically lack competitive advantage versus specialized semiconductor manufacturers, representing a notable competitive positioning risk.
evidence.market_timing: Under 기술선도 strategy, completing 1-2 years before boom is ideal; all three technologies complete roughly 1.25-1.75 years after their respective boom windows, which is suboptimal but not severely misaligned — the roadmap would have benefited from earlier start dates.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The portfolio covers technologies with known patent and market activity in ADAS/EV domains, but there is no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; the selection appears driven by market opportunity scores rather than systematic patent-market overlap analysis.

strengths: All selected technologies are domain-relevant to Autonomous Driving/ADAS, avoiding major domain drift and leveraging existing organizational competencies
TRL progression timelines are technically credible with no physically implausible development leaps, and budget is fully utilized without violation
weaknesses: All three technologies complete after their market boom windows rather than before, contradicting the 기술선도 preemption principle and reducing first-mover advantage
Portfolio skews too high in TRL (6-7) for a declared technology leadership strategy; inclusion of TRL7 T03 as Strategic tier undermines the R&D-exploratory nature expected of 기술선도
missing_technologies: Low-TRL autonomous decision-making AI / end-to-end neural driving stack (TRL 3-4) for genuine technology leadership
V2X / Vehicle-to-Everything communication platform aligned with 2028-2030 connected vehicle market growth
LiDAR solid-state sensor technology at early TRL for preemptive positioning in next-generation ADAS sensing
investment_issues: T03 (TRL7, near-commercial) is assigned Strategic tier — this level of investment is more appropriate for exploratory technologies; High tier would suffice for a mature technology requiring only productization

T02 (SiC semiconductor manufacturing) at Strategic tier assumes the company can compete in semiconductor fabrication, which requires entirely different capital infrastructure and expertise than ADAS software/systems integration
timing_issues: 스테어 바이 와이어 제어 completes in 2028-Q1, approximately 1.25 years after the 2026-Q4 boom — misses the preemption window entirely and risks entering a maturing market
다중 센서 퓨전 카메라 completes in 2029-Q1, 1.75 years after the 2027-Q2 boom — the longest delay in the portfolio, significantly reducing competitive impact

고성능 SiC 반도체 제조 completes in 2030-Q1, 1.5 years after the 2028-Q3 boom — all three technologies share the same systematic late-completion pattern suggesting start dates should be advanced by 6-8 quarters
